about: The drawn film's shot list, written by Muse Spark from docs/CHIP-FILM.md, checked by viz/drawn/reel.py.

shots.plate: black void with faint glowing lattice points
shots.action: a single grain drifts in and slowly turns, lit from one side
shots.grain: drift-turn: grain of sand with big round eyes rotating slowly
shots.caption: This is a grain of sand.
shots.board: tiny sand grain glowing in blackness as camera pushes in

shots.plate: black void filling with glowing lattice and scale bar 1mm to atoms
shots.action: grain fills screen, surface resolves into glowing atomic lattice, title appears
shots.grain: fill-screen: grain of sand face fills frame, surface becomes lattice
shots.caption: By the end of this film, it will be thinking.
shots.board: grain fills screen revealing lattice and title From Sand to Chip

shots.plate: dawn open-pit quartz quarry with stepped terraces
shots.action: excavator scoops white rock into haul truck at dawn
shots.grain: ride-along: quartz molecule Grain holding hands with two red oxygen twins in rock
shots.others: oxygen twins: hand-hold pose clinging to Grain
shots.caption: A beach is mostly quartz, but chips start from something cleaner:
shots.board: wide quarry at dawn with excavator loading white rock

shots.plate: quarry road to crusher with conveyor
shots.action: haul truck rolls to crusher, rock becomes gravel on conveyor
shots.grain: tumble-ride: Grain with oxygen twins bouncing on conveyor gravel
shots.caption: quartz rock, dug out of the ground.
shots.board: truck dumps rock into crusher feeding gravel conveyor

shots.plate: close-up on one pebble with molecule pop-out background
shots.action: callout pops from pebble showing SiO2 molecule labelled quartz
shots.grain: pose-label: Grain center holding hands with two red oxygen twins as SiO2
shots.others: oxygen twins: present-pose flanking Grain with leader line
shots.caption: It is silicon locked to oxygen.
shots.board: pebble bursts into SiO2 diagram with one silicon and two oxygens

shots.plate: arc furnace exterior glowing white-orange
shots.action: gravel pours into furnace with carbon mix
shots.grain: pour-fall: quartz Grain with oxygen twins falling into furnace
shots.others: oxygen twins: cling-pose, carbon thieves: lurk-pose black lumps waiting
shots.caption: Heat it with carbon, hotter than lava,
shots.board: gravel tipping into blazing arc furnace mouth

shots.plate: cutaway inside furnace with atom inset
shots.action: red oxygen peel off grey silicon and fly away with black carbon as puffs
shots.grain: stolen-from: grey silicon lump face sad as twins pulled away
shots.others: oxygen twins: peel-away carried off, carbon thieves: steal-grab dragging oxygens
shots.effects: sparks, little gas puffs, temperature callout
shots.caption: and the carbon steals the oxygen.
shots.board: atoms split as black carbons steal red oxygens from grey silicon

shots.plate: cooling trough beside furnace
shots.action: grey silicon pours out and cools solid
shots.grain: cool-lump: grey silicon lump with face, twins gone
shots.caption: Grey silicon is left behind.
shots.board: grey silicon stream cooling into dull lump

shots.plate: glass distillation column interior
shots.action: grey lump dissolves into swirling lilac gas
shots.grain: dissolve-swirl: lilac wisp of gas with face forming
shots.others: specks: swirl-pose dark dots mixed in gas
shots.caption: So the silicon becomes a gas,
shots.board: grey lump melting into swirling gas in glass column

shots.plate: mid-column filters with purity meter
shots.action: specks filtered out each pass as meter climbs 99% to 99.99%
shots.grain: shake-off: lilac wisp shaking off dark specks
shots.caption: is distilled again and again,
shots.board: gas rising through filters shedding specks as counter climbs

shots.plate: top of column with solid rods and billion-marble grid
shots.action: gas freezes back into solid rods, purity hits 99.9999999%
shots.grain: freeze-rod: wisp condensing toward solid rod shape keeping face
shots.others: specks: gone, one wrong marble in grid
shots.caption: and freezes back into solid rods.
shots.board: pure gas freezing into solid rods beside purity counter

shots.plate: crucible of molten silicon glowing white-orange
shots.action: seed on rod dips into melt
shots.grain: seed-dip: tiny crystal face on seed rod touching melt
shots.caption: Now the atoms have to line up.
shots.board: seed rod dipping into glowing silicon melt

shots.plate: melt surface close-up
shots.action: rod rises slowly while spinning, pulling crystal up
shots.grain: pull-spin: growing tall silver ingot with face and seed rod on top spinning
shots.caption: A seed crystal touches the melt and is pulled up slowly while it spins.
shots.board: seed rising and spinning pulling crystal column upward

shots.plate: growth front grid background
shots.action: close-up atoms snap into perfect grid as they leave melt
shots.grain: snap-grid: ingot face watching atoms lock into grid
shots.caption: Atom by atom, the melt freezes onto it in perfect order:
shots.board: atoms clicking into perfect lattice at crystal edge

shots.plate: pull hall with small human figure for scale
shots.action: pull back to reveal silver ingot as tall as human, temperature dial shows
shots.grain: tall-stand: tall silver crystal ingot with face and seed rod on top beside human
shots.caption: one giant crystal.
shots.board: giant silver ingot towering beside tiny human figure

shots.plate: saw room with ingot on its side
shots.action: taut diamond wire glints through ingot, discs fall in sequence
shots.grain: slice-fall: ingot face sectioning, discs with face falling
shots.caption: A diamond wire slices it into discs
shots.board: wire slicing sideways ingot into thin discs

shots.plate: polishing station with mirror reflection
shots.action: one disc tilts to camera and polishes to mirror shine
shots.grain: mirror-polish: thin mirror-bright wafer disc with face reflecting scene
shots.caption: thinner than a coin,
shots.board: thin disc polishing until it mirrors the room

shots.plate: clean box station with dust-transistor split screen
shots.action: polished disc slides into sealed box with 24 others
shots.grain: box-slide: wafer disc with face sliding into box of 25
shots.caption: polished until they shine like mirrors.
shots.board: mirror wafer sliding into sealed box of 25

shots.plate: dark fab exterior with teal light seams and door sign
shots.action: box rides overhead track toward fab door, robot CEO stamps it
shots.grain: box-ride: wafer in sealed box of 25 with face peeking, riding track
shots.others: Lou Latency: stamp-pose boxy robot in suit stamping simulated from here
shots.caption: The wafers enter the fab in lots of 25.
shots.board: box on overhead rail arriving as robot stamps it

shots.plate: fab interior diorama with teal border frame
shots.action: box continues inside under teal frame tagged SMT2020 simulated
shots.grain: inside-box: wafer face inside box under teal frame
shots.caption: From this moment on, the simulator follows every one of them.
shots.board: box gliding into teal-lit fab interior with frame overlay

shots.plate: close-up on bare wafer in process chamber
shots.action: mist settles as film, wafer looks up
shots.grain: film-watch: wafer with face getting mist film
shots.caption: Here is the trick:
shots.board: mist filming over close-up wafer

shots.plate: yellow lithography room with mask
shots.action: UV light through mask prints pattern
shots.grain: light-print: wafer face lit by patterned UV
shots.caption: a chip is built like a city, one floor at a time.
shots.board: yellow room flashing pattern onto wafer with light

shots.plate: etch chamber with violet plasma
shots.action: violet plasma carves trenches, then atom beam buries itself
shots.grain: etch-dose: wafer face braving plasma then atom beam
shots.caption: A film, a pattern printed with light,
shots.board: plasma carving trenches then beam dosing atoms

shots.plate: wash and check stations
shots.action: water sheet sweeps clean, scanning line gives green tick
shots.grain: wash-check: wafer face washed then ticked green
shots.effects: water sheet, scan line, green tick pop
shots.caption: an etch, a dose of atoms,
shots.board: water washing wafer then scanner marking green tick

shots.plate: loop repeat chambers blurred
shots.action: lap two at double speed through all stages
shots.grain: lap-two: wafer coach starting to show tiled dies with red headband spinning fast
shots.caption: a wash, a check.
shots.board: wafer whirling fast through film to check again

shots.plate: stacking floors like building with counters
shots.action: time-lapse floors stack, counters run to 583
shots.grain: stack-up: wafer coach with red headband gaining floors
shots.caption: Then the loop begins again.
shots.board: wafer growing tall with stacked city floors and counter

shots.plate: same stacking building continuing
shots.action: floors keep stacking toward full height
shots.grain: build-high: wafer coach tiled with coloured dies wearing red headband rising
shots.board: tower of layers climbing higher in time-lapse

shots.plate: completed layered city-wafer
shots.action: loop ends on finished layered wafer coach
shots.grain: done-coach: wafer coach tiled with coloured dies and red headband smiling
shots.board: finished wafer-city with many floors complete

shots.plate: reveal stage with stained-glass light
shots.action: wafer rises and turns to face us, mosaic of dies catching light
shots.grain: mosaic-face: one die face among wafer coach tiles
shots.others: sibling dies: tile-pose hundreds identical around Grain
shots.caption: Out comes a wafer tiled with identical chips,
shots.board: wafer rising to show mosaic of identical dies

shots.plate: dive into one die streets of transistors
shots.action: camera dives into one die showing transistor streets, teal border fades
shots.grain: dive-center: single die face in center as camera dives
shots.caption: millions to billions of tiny switches in each.
shots.board: dive into one die revealing transistor streets

shots.plate: probe station top-down with needle bed
shots.action: bed of fine needles lowers onto die
shots.grain: needle-wince: die with face under lowering needles
shots.caption: Not every die works.
shots.board: needle bed lowering onto die from above

shots.plate: same probe station with tally overlay
shots.action: most dies light green, one blinks red and gets dot
shots.grain: test-pass: die face lighting green, neighbor red-dotted
shots.others: sibling dies: pass-pose green, one fail-pose red with dot
shots.caption: Needles finer than a hair put each one through a quick exam.
shots.board: dies flashing green pass and one red fail with dot

shots.plate: grinding backside with wafer flipped
shots.action: wafer flips, ground thinner, flips back
shots.grain: flip-grind: die face flipped and thinned
shots.caption: Cut along the narrow streets between them,
shots.board: wafer flipping and grinding thinner

shots.plate: dicing streets grid
shots.action: laser line runs along streets, grid separates like chocolate bar
shots.grain: break-free: single die cut free with face alone
shots.caption: each die is finally on its own.
shots.board: laser cutting grid that breaks into separate dies

shots.plate: green board square close three-quarter
shots.action: one die settles onto board, gold wires arc from edges
shots.grain: wire-bond: die with face getting gold wire arcs
shots.caption: A bare die is tiny and fragile,
shots.board: die landing on green square with gold wires arcing

shots.plate: same package station with exploded view labels
shots.action: black lid closes over die forming package
shots.grain: lidded-home: die in black package with gold wires and face peeking
shots.caption: so it gets a home that links it to the world.
shots.board: black lid closing over wired die

shots.plate: tray with three speed bins and chart
shots.action: chips line up, light sweeps, sort into three bins by speed
shots.grain: sort-ride: packaged chip with face sorted on tray
shots.others: sibling dies: sort-pose in bins as packaged chips
shots.caption: Tested, sorted and shipped.
shots.board: chips sweeping into three bins by speed

shots.plate: phone on beach from cold open
shots.action: one chip lifts, flies into phone, screen wakes, pull back to beach
shots.grain: phone-wake: packaged chip with face flying into phone that lights up
shots.caption: The journey that began on a beach ends in your pocket.
shots.board: chip flying into phone waking up on beach
